description: Generate silly five-line limericks with a true AABBA rhyme scheme from rhyming word banks.

faqs.a: Lines 1, 2 and 5 share one rhyme; lines 3 and 4 share another, shorter rhyme — enforced by the word banks.
Rhyming pairs like Nantucket/bucket and places, people and mishaps are picked fresh each time.
faqs.q: Where do the rhymes come from?
Will I get a different limerick each time?
faqs.a: Yes — the person, place, action and rhyme pairs are picked randomly on every generate.

title: Limerick Generator
